reference_sql:
WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS month
  FROM range(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2026-01-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
), invited AS (
  -- one row per month with invited users
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', invited_at) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS users_invited
  FROM users
  WHERE invited_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND invited_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', invited_at) AS DATE)
)
SELECT m.month, COALESCE(i.users_invited, 0) AS users_invited
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN invited i ON i.month = m.month
